$comment: AD-23 wants one token file read by CSS, TypeScript and a Node test runner. Node reads these sources directly with type stripping — which `erasableSyntaxOnly` in the base config already guarantees is possible — and that needs `./x.ts` import specifiers; `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` turns them into `./x.js` on emit, so dist/ is still ordinary ESM. Tests are excluded from the build and typechecked by tsconfig.tools.json instead, so the emitted package carries no test and no vitest import.
